evidence_after.text: 3.2 Shared-private Feature Extractor Shared-private feature extractor is mainly used for extracting shared features and private features among different tasks. In this paper, we apply the encoder module of transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) (henceforth, transformer encoder) to the shared-private extractor of our model. Specially, we employ two transformer encoders to encode the input embeddings of the two tasks as their respec- tive private features.
